title: Orkan: Cache-friendly simulation of quantum operations on hermitian operators
summary: Classical simulation of quantum operations is essential for algorithm design, noise characterisation, and benchmarking of quantum hardware. The most general physically realisable operation can be described by a positive linear map acting on a hermitian operator, representing either a density matrix or an observable. Established simulators vectorise the density matrix on an $n$-qubit Hilbert space and reuse state-vector kernels, storing all $2^{2n}$ elements and forgoing the benefits of hermitian symmetry.
